				else_if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = politicker_attribute level >= 2 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|politicker_attribute|2" }
				else_if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = politicker_attribute level >= 1 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|politicker_attribute|1" }
				else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|politicker_attribute|0" }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_accolade_type = tactician_attribute }
				if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = tactician_attribute level >= 3 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|tactician_attribute|3" }
				else_if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = tactician_attribute level >= 2 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|tactician_attribute|2" }
				else_if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = tactician_attribute level >= 1 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|tactician_attribute|1" }
				else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|tactician_attribute|0" }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_accolade_type = reeve_attribute }
				if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = reeve_attribute level >= 3 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|reeve_attribute|3" }
				else_if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = reeve_attribute level >= 2 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|reeve_attribute|2" }
				else_if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = reeve_attribute level >= 1 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|reeve_attribute|1" }
				else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|reeve_attribute|0" }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_accolade_type = manipulator_attribute }
				if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = manipulator_attribute level >= 3 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|manipulator_attribute|3" }
				else_if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = manipulator_attribute level >= 2 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|manipulator_attribute|2" }
				else_if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = manipulator_attribute level >= 1 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|manipulator_attribute|1" }
				else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|manipulator_attribute|0" }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_accolade_type = mentor_attribute }
				if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = mentor_attribute level >= 3 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|mentor_attribute|3" }
				else_if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = mentor_attribute level >= 2 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|mentor_attribute|2" }
				else_if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = mentor_attribute level >= 1 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|mentor_attribute|1" }
				else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|mentor_attribute|0" }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_accolade_type = contender_attribute }
				if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = contender_attribute level >= 3 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|contender_attribute|3" }
				else_if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = contender_attribute level >= 2 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|contender_attribute|2" }
				else_if = { limit = { accolade_attribute_level = { type = contender_attribute level >= 1 } } info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|contender_attribute|1" }
				else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|CX|acc_type|contender_attribute|0" }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Army scope (A and J records), after the AX lines. Only marauder_attribute reads it.
ck3xbl_emit_army_uncontrolled_effect = {
	army_owner = { save_temporary_scope_as = ck3xbl_ax_owner }
	if = {
		limit = { location = { barony_controller ?= scope:ck3xbl_ax_owner } }
		info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|uncontrolled|no"
	}
	else = { info_log = "CK3XBL|AX|uncontrolled|yes" }
}

# Write-back (apply effect, root = the player, registers as in PROTOCOL 2.2). Proposed glory block: 8 pairs
# (character tag, 1000 + glory) at r122..r129 and r190..r197. Call it BEFORE the character slots, so a knight who
# dies still adds his glory to his own accolade before it passes to the successor. Vanilla on_combat_end_winner /
# _loser (combat_event.2101 +25 / .2111 -10) still run after force_win: the bridge never sends those amounts.
ck3xbl_apply_glory_slot_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:$TAG$ > 0
			var:$GLORY$ > 0
			NOT = { var:$GLORY$ = 1000 }
		}
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = ck3xbl_chars
			limit = {
				has_variable = ck3xbl_tag
				var:ck3xbl_tag = root.var:$TAG$
				is_acclaimed = yes
			}
			accolade = {
				add_glory = {
					value = root.var:$GLORY$
					subtract = 1000
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
# ck3xbl_apply_glory_slot_effect = { TAG = ck3xbl_r122 GLORY = ck3xbl_r123 }  ... r128/r129, r190/r191 ... r196/r197
